issue.title: bob-mac-capture macOS CI red again since Go To commits fde8211/70c0839/5960b31: backslash insert helper, chip refetch, and error-prefix XCTests fail and swift test hits the 15-minute guard
issue.description:
bob-mac-capture master macOS CI went red again a few hours after `933091b`/`2884ea2`
restored it (run 41888215951 on `4906d94` was green end to end). Three Go To commits
landed without a lander: `fde8211` (backslash opens Go To), `70c0839` (synchronize Go To
scope snapshots), and `5960b31` (Command-X switches to completed tasks only). Their runs
41889511461, 41889993205, and 41900858873 all fail.

Failures in run 41900858873 (`5960b31`):

- `CaptureBackslashGotoTests.testInsertHelperDeclinesWhileComposingSubmittingOrLocked`
  (`CaptureBackslashGotoTests.swift:415`): `XCTAssertEqual failed: ("\") is not equal to ("")`.
  The insert helper leaves `\` in the draft when it should decline.
- `CaptureTaskGotoPanelTests.testDelayedChipRefetchCannotReplaceReopenedSnapshot`
  (`CaptureTaskGotoPanelTests.swift:487/493/501`): two "Condition not met before timeout"
  failures, then `Optional(1)` != `Optional(8)`.
- `CaptureTaskGotoPanelTests.testFailureOnChipRefetchRetainsRowsAndReportsError`
  (`CaptureTaskGotoPanelTests.swift:605`): the reported error is now prefixed with
  `bob command failed (exit 7): .../fake-bob capture-complete --all-tasks --closed-tasks ...`
  but the test expects the bare `controlled Go To fixture failure`.
- The Test step also hit the workflow's "swift test ran longer than 15 minutes; sampling
  xctest" guard. Use the uploaded xctest samples to find the hang.

Fix each root cause separately: product where the test reflects the intended contract,
and the test where the contract changed deliberately (for example the error-prefix
format). Do not delete or weaken tests. A green Test step is what lets Bundle, Launch
smoke, and Install run, so every Mac change ships unverified until this is fixed. Linux
hosts cannot run these tests, so verify on the exact-SHA macOS run (see bob-cli-1x).

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: The same assertions fail on three consecutive master SHAs (fde8211, 70c0839, 5960b31) after a fully green 4906d94; the error-prefix mismatch is a deterministic string difference.

issue.creation_reason: Mac master CI was green at 4906d94 and went red with three Go To commits that had no lander; the lead researcher of the research.3b bead-triage swarm found no bead or running agent that owns these failures.

payload.description: The process gap (pushing Mac code without watching macOS CI) that let these Go To failures land
